Great Food, Lovely Place and Superb Customer Service
Nov 2022
Definitely one of the best dining experience in HCM. I’m not one for reviews but this restaurant deserves all the accolades it gets. Highly recommended and will come back for sure!

Food ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had the kombucha, their signature drink, which was freshly made and just the right amount of tartness and sweetness for me. It was delicious for a health drink that I even got a second one for take away. The chicken coconut curry and cheese nan is super tasty. I was surprised at myself that I almost finished all of it. Single servings are big for a regular-built woman as me, and normally I wouldn’t be able to down that much but it was so good that my plate’s almost clean when I finished. Lol. The flavor of the curry is very rich and by far the best in HCM I have ever tried. Food was served fairly quick too. Prices are reasonable and totally worth it. If you come here, kombucha is a must-try!

Ambiance ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

This got to be something that needs special mention because the place and the vibes are so delightful. Imagine chill Sunday morning by the pool side and clear skies and a homey interior, with a lowkey relaxing music on the background. Plus, there’s the adorable cat who I really love at first meow!

Customer Service ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Service was brilliant and top notch! Linh is very accommodating and offers excellent service. He’s warm and friendly which makes you feel very much welcome to the restaurant. He speaks good English and such a smart person to talk to, even explained and helped me choose from the menu.

Overall Experience ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It’s incredible to know a hidden gem as OnTap in the city! It got great reviews too with its former name, fuAsian, that’s got me curious and I'm glad to have decided to give it a try. Here’s hoping that more people will know about it! Overall impressive and memorable experience.

Great food, amazing staffs
Aug 2022 • Solo
A lovely poolside restaurant crafting the unique drink Kombucha.
It's basically fermented, lightly effervescent, sweetened black tea. There are many different fruit flavors to choose, but my favorite is the Pina Colada flavor.

As for foods, you can have dishes from around the world.

Also, this place is so cozy.
I stayed at SONATA Resistances (hotel/apartment in the same building) for 14 days and i went here almost every day. The staffs are so helpful, friendly and many speak fluent English. 
Good place to meet up too, I made some friends here.

Yes I only wrote good things, because I literally don't have any bad memories about this place.
I bet On Tap will warmly welcome your visit too.

I would love to go again when I'll be back to ho chi minh.

Another Saigon, in Saigon

The space is different from the bustle that you often encounter in HCMC. The food is unique and has its own flavor that you cannot find anywhere else. The signature drink is kombucha which is delicious and healthy. A month living here, I can't help but drink kombucha every day. and the amazing thing is that despite eating a lot of delicious food here, my weight has not changed thanks to kombucha. I miss this taste so much. Besides, the restaurant owner and staff are very friendly, you can chat and play pool with them when they have time. Sometimes the owner even surprises you because the dishes she creates are not on the menu. I will definitely come back here.
